title: Building
description: Work on the inn itself, bought at the desk (Building work). Each upgrade raises the building's insulation, which the room's warmth reads; they come in order, each after the one before.

insulation.description: The building's insulation once it's done: -2 leaky … 2 snug.

daysClosed.description: Days the inn can't open while the builders work, starting the morning after it's bought.

text.description: What the work is, for the card's back.
